description: USGS earthquake events ingested into the system. Has PostGIS geog column for spatial queries.

columns.name: geog
columns.description: PostGIS geography point — use with ST_DWithin/ST_Distance for radius queries

exampleQueries: SELECT id, mag, place, event_time FROM earthquakes WHERE event_time > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' ORDER BY mag DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

SELECT id, mag, place, ST_Distance(geog, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.4194, 37.7749), 4326)::geography) / 1000.0 AS distance_km FROM earthquakes WHERE ST_DWithin(geog, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.4194, 37.7749), 4326)::geography, 500000) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 10
notes: For agent spatial queries, prefer the postgis_query tool over raw SQL. The geog column is indexed with GiST. Distances from ST_Distance are in meters — divide by 1000 for km. ST_DWithin(geog, point, radius_meters) filters by radius.
